certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Official Colorado Secretary of State historical election data portal President results CSV. County rows are parsed and reconciled against the State row.

turnout.notes: Colorado county turnout comes from the official 2024 Abstract of Votes Cast. The importer reads the 2024 General Election table calculated as a percentage of registered voters and validates the published statewide registered-voter and ballots-cast totals.

certifiedResults.title: Colorado official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County presidential totals are parsed from the Colorado Secretary of State historical election data portal President results CSV and reconciled against the State row.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Colorado Secretary of State historical election data portal identifies the 2024 Nov 5 General President contest and provides a Results CSV download.

wardDetail.title: Colorado precinct or reporting-unit detail
wardDetail.detail: The official CSV also contains precinct rows, but this baseline promotion imports county rows only. Review drilldowns need a mapped precinct review parser before they can be enabled.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Precinct rows are present in the Colorado CSV but not yet mapped into review graphs.

turnout.title: Colorado official county turnout

turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official 2024 Abstract of Votes Cast explains registered-voter turnout tables at the back of the abstract.
